review_candidates.title: Service Desk Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Service Desk Engineer (L1 / L1.5) is responsible for providing first-line technical support and service request management for ZainTECH's Managed Services customers across the GCC. Working closely with the Network Operations Centre (NOC), Managed Services Engineering teams, Customer Success Managers, and other operational stakeholders, the Service Desk Engineer provides initial troubleshooting, incident classification, customer communication, and escalation management.
